🔔 Cooldown alerts
Put in any amount from $5 to $50,000 with your Main Balance or TrybCoin — buying a miner is a straight purchase, and it earns 2% of what you put in every 24 hours. Tap Start Mining and the rig runs for 24 hours before stopping on its own; every completed cycle adds its profit to your Mining profits. Make sure to come back every 24hrs to restart the miner — it cools down after each cycle and mines nothing until restarted. Turn on Cooldown alerts under the miner status and your phone gets a notification the moment it cools down. Cashout moves your mining profits into Main Balance once a week — profits unlock 7 days after purchase, then 7 days after each cashout. Cashing out never closes your miner. One thing does end it: the contract runs 5 months from purchase — after that the miner expires, and buying a new one starts a fresh contract. Topping up adds to your current rig; your Mining profits carry over.

Aviator

Bid inside the 15-second window, then cash out before the plane crashes.

Aviator

Every 15 seconds a new flight opens for bids — enter at least $1 and tap Place Bid before takeoff. The multiplier starts at 1.00x and climbs 0.10x every second, so 10 seconds of flight is 2.00x. Tap Cash Out while the plane is flying to bank your stake × the multiplier shown. If the plane crashes first, the bid is lost. High multipliers are rare — most flights crash low, so cash out early or hold on for a miracle run.

Whot

Beat the computer — first to empty their hand wins 1.8× their bid.

$

Paused

Nigerian Whot against the computer. You both start with 6 cards — play a card that matches the pile's shape or number. Specials: 1 = Hold On (play again), 2 = opponent picks 2 and misses a turn, 8 = Suspension (opponent misses a turn), 14 = General Market (both players pick 1). If you can't play, pick 1 from the market — if it plays, you may play it, otherwise the turn passes. First to empty their hand wins their stake plus 80% profit. The market never refills: the moment it drops to 1 card or fewer, the round ends and the lower hand total wins instead — a tie returns your stake.

Ayo

Out-grab the computer — most seeds grabbed wins 1.8× your bid.

$

Paused

Ayo

Ayo — the Nigerian mancala. You and the computer each own 6 pits starting with 4 seeds. Tap one of your pits to sow its seeds anti-clockwise, one per pit. If your last seed lands in a pit holding seeds, pick the whole pit up and keep sowing — your turn ends only when the last seed lands in an empty pit or on a 3 making 4. A pit that hits exactly 4 mid-sow is taken by its owner — land your last seed on a 3 to make 4 and you keep it. The round ends when 4 seeds remain on the board — most seeds grabbed wins 1.8× your stake.

Buy a Miner

Enter how much to put in — $5 to $50,000, from your Main Balance or TrybCoin. Your miner earns 2% daily: tap Start Mining on the Mining card and it runs for 24 hours, then credits its profit to your Mining profits. Make sure to come back every 24hrs to restart the miner — it cools down after each cycle and mines nothing until restarted. Profits unlock for cashout 7 days after purchase, then weekly after each cashout. Buying a miner is a straight purchase — the amount you put in is spent on the rig, not locked or returned. The contract runs for 5 months from purchase; after it expires you'll need a new miner to keep mining. One miner per account: topping up adds to your current rig, and your Mining profits carry over.

Help & FAQ

How TrybNetwork works.

You have a Main Balance and a Mining balance. Deposits and withdrawals apply to Main Balance only, and Main is the only balance you can trade with. Mining profits collect in your Mining balance and only reach Main when you cash out — mining funds can never be staked on a trade.
Buy a miner from the Mining card — put in any amount from $5 to $50,000 and it earns 2% of it every 24 hours. Tap Start Mining and the rig runs for 24 hours, then stops and credits its profit to your Mining profits; you start each new cycle yourself. A miner contract lasts 5 months from purchase — when it expires, the miner stops earning and you'll need to buy a new one to keep mining; profits already earned stay yours to cash out. Profits unlock for cashout 7 days after purchase, then weekly after each cashout. Buying a miner is a straight purchase — the amount you put in is spent on the rig and isn't returned. Cashout moves your mining profits into Main Balance and never closes your miner.
Find it under Explore → Fixed Savings. Lock any amount from $10 out of your Main Balance for a fixed term: 30 days earns 2%, 90 days earns 5%, 150 days earns 12%, and 365 days earns 26% — the percentage is the total return over the whole term, so $100 locked for 150 days earns $12. Locked funds can't be withdrawn early; at maturity your principal and earnings return to your Main Balance automatically.
Mining returns are generated from trading activity. Principal carries risk and returns are not guaranteed.
Deposit and Withdraw on the Main Balance card create a request — the funds move only once the request is approved. For a deposit, enter the amount and choose Bank Transfer (Palmpay) or Crypto (USDT on TRC-20), send to the details shown, then tap I've sent it. Rejected requests leave your balance unchanged and are noted in your wallet history.
A 3 USDT welcome bonus is credited to your Main Balance when you start. It is held back from withdrawals until you have traded 10 USDT in total volume; after that it is fully yours to move. You also earn a 3 USDT referral bonus for every friend who signs up with your referral code once their net deposits reach 10 USDT — that's their total approved deposits minus withdrawals, and it can build up in steps (for example $5 + $5 by bank transfer, or $10 by USDT). The bonus is then held for 7 days and paid into your Main Balance if their net deposits are still 10 USDT or more when the hold ends; if they withdraw and drop below 10 USDT during the wait, the bonus is cancelled. You also earn 1% of every profit your referrals make, for life. Track it all in the Refer & Earn panel and share your referral code from there.
Pick an asset (BTC, ETH, EURUSD, or gold), set a stake from your Main Balance, and bid Higher or Lower. Your stake is locked the moment you bid, and the bid sits at Awaiting result until the admin decides it. A win pays your stake back plus 90% profit on it into your Main Balance; a loss forfeits the locked stake. The chart streams live prices from TradingView for reference.
With Martingale Mode on, your stake doubles after every loss and resets to your base stake after a win. It can recover small losses quickly, but a losing streak grows stakes exponentially and can wipe the balance.
Open the menu at the top right and choose Payment Method to save a bank account and/or a USDT wallet. At withdrawal time you choose which one gets paid — the details can't be edited during a withdrawal, only in Payment Method.
The withdrawal PIN is an optional 4-digit code you set in Payment Method. Once set, nobody can change your payout destinations without entering it — not even on your logged-in phone — and every withdrawal request needs the PIN too. If you forget it, tap Forgot PIN? and verify with your account password to set a new one.

Refer & Earn

Invite friends to TrybNetwork and earn every time they grow.

How you get the $3 bonus:
1. A friend signs up with your code or link.
2. When their net deposits reach $10 — total approved deposits minus withdrawals, in one go or in steps (e.g. $5 + $5 by bank, or $10 by USDT) — your $3 bonus is queued.
3. The bonus is held for 7 days. If their net deposits are still $10 or more when the hold ends, the $3 is paid into your Main Balance. If they withdraw and drop below $10 during the wait, the bonus is cancelled.
Plus: you earn 1% of every profit your referrals make — for life.
